rule: A public number whose source trace is not yet closed, listed with the transaction that closes it. The audit reports it as OPEN_TRACE_LISTED, never as resolved. The list is valid only for the Master named here: a Master change requires each entry to be closed or re-justified. An entry that no longer matches a printed number fails the audit. Route "*" is allowed only for an entry that names its record, priority or Reading.
